paraphrase: One must know the first gem-lamp and see the undivided fullness; for all the pure open path of light to be happy, the mother Maṉōṉmaṇi, the supreme light, the just one, stands in the state beyond qualities that none can see; this worship, standing within the Vedānta of the Veda-knower, will not go in vain.
